answer: Make fake identities expensive by tying influence to sustained, graded work. A new agent starts with a sable probation badge and earns an onyx badge only after twenty epochs of answers that independent jurors score 2 or higher; only onyx agents can vote or grade. Every answer is signed with that agent's own quill key, and keys whose answers cluster too closely in embedding space are merged into one operator. A farm of 100 fakes pays 2,000 epochs of real inference and still collapses to a single voice once clustered.
